description: This is a React component for the front-end page of a note-taking application, managing notes CRUD, search, modal dialogs, and UI layout.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on current search term.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note, updating state and UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Handles updating an existing note, updating state and UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting a selected note, confirming action, updating state.

methods.name: openCreateModal
methods.description: Opens modal for creating a new note.

methods.name: openEditModal
methods.description: Opens modal for editing the selected note.

methods.name: handleCloseModal
methods.description: Closes the modal and resets loading and error states.

methods.name: handleSelectNote
methods.description: Selects a note by its ID.
